title: VP of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: As a manufacturer of large-format inkjet printers for signage, displays, and vehicle wraps, Agfa's product portfolio success depends on the total solution quality their customers can deliver. The VP of Product Management owns product strategy, differentiation, and competitive positioning. They would care deeply about Tedlar because: (1) Agfa can recommend or co-market Tedlar as the premium overlaminate choice alongside their Jeti Tauro, Anapurna Ciervo, and Onset Grizzly printers, creating a complete durability story that enhances their value proposition; (2) Their customers' warranty claims and complaints about print durability reflect back on Agfa's printer performance—partnering with Tedlar (12-20+ year outdoor lifespan, UV protection, graffiti resistance) enables Agfa to deliver documented durability outcomes that protect their brand reputation; (3) Product Management owns customer success metrics and could drive Tedlar into reference architectures, technical specifications, and sales training materials; (4) Given Agfa's premium positioning and presence at FESPA, ISA Sign Expo, and winning 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards, they need premium material partners to maintain market leadership. Tedlar enables Agfa to claim the most durable end-to-end solution in outdoor graphics, supporting higher printer ASPs and customer lifetime value.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: The VP of Product Management owns strategic product roadmap, competitive positioning, and total solution differentiation for Agfa's large-format printer portfolio (Jeti Tauro, Anapurna Ciervo, Onset Grizzly). This role sits at the intersection of customer requirements, market trends, and technical capabilities—likely reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer or Chief Technology Officer, with direct influence over Technical Services, Applications Engineering, and Sales enablement teams. They decide which materials, partnerships, and solution bundles get integrated into go-to-market strategy, product documentation, and customer reference architectures. While they don't purchase protective films directly, they control whether Tedlar becomes part of Agfa's recommended solution stack and sales narrative.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Given Agfa's focus on outdoor signage, vehicle wraps, retail displays, and architectural graphics, the most relevant Tedlar use cases for this VP are: (1) Outdoor signage and graphics—where Agfa's customers face warranty claims from UV degradation and weathering, making Tedlar's UV protection and extreme temperature resistance (-70°F to 230°F) a competitive differentiator for the complete Agfa solution; (2) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics—where graffiti resistance and ease of cleaning directly reduce maintenance costs for Agfa's end customers, strengthening Agfa's value proposition in the fleet graphics segment; (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps—where Tedlar's proven outdoor performance (12-20+ years) enables Agfa to compete for high-profile, long-warranty installations that premium printers like the Jeti Tauro are designed to serve. This VP's team benefits by being able to sell complete durability solutions rather than just printing equipment, reducing post-sale support burden and protecting Agfa's brand reputation when prints fail prematurely due to inadequate protection.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This role likely owns KPIs around product differentiation, competitive win rates, customer satisfaction scores, and revenue per printer sold. Their success depends on Agfa's ability to command premium pricing and win against HP, Canon, and Epson in head-to-head competitive situations. When Agfa's customers experience print failures—fading, cracking, graffiti damage—it reflects poorly on Agfa's printers even when the root cause is inferior overlaminate choice. Conversely, when Agfa can point to validated 15-20 year outdoor performance by recommending Tedlar, it justifies higher printer ASPs and strengthens customer retention. This VP personally cares about reducing technical support escalations (which stem from field failures), improving Net Promoter Scores from sign manufacturers and print service providers, and having clear competitive differentiation stories for their sales teams. Tedlar solves their problem of incomplete solution ownership—they can't control what overlaminate their customers choose, but by establishing Tedlar as the validated partner, they gain control over the total outcome quality that determines Agfa's brand reputation.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Agfa just won three 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards from PRINTING United Alliance and showcased new printers at FESPA Global Print Expo and ISA International Sign Expo 2024. This recognition and market visibility creates urgency to solidify their premium positioning with differentiated partnerships. Additionally, with FESPA and ISA being annual events where Agfa competes directly with HP, Canon, and Epson, establishing a Tedlar partnership NOW enables joint marketing programs, co-branded booth materials, and customer case studies to be ready for the next show cycle. Product Management operates on 6-12 month planning horizons for go-to-market initiatives, making this the ideal time to introduce Tedlar as a strategic partner before their 2026 trade show and product launch calendar is finalized.

personalization_hooks.hook: Agfa's customers (sign manufacturers, print service providers, vehicle wrap installers) are the direct purchasers of Tedlar, creating natural channel alignment where Tedlar's success with Agfa's customer base strengthens Agfa's competitive position
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame the conversation as a strategic partnership opportunity rather than a vendor pitch—emphasize how Tedlar can be positioned as the validated overlaminate choice in Agfa's technical specifications, sales training, and customer reference materials, creating a differentiated total solution story

personalization_hooks.hook: Agfa recently won 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards and maintains premium positioning through presence at FESPA and ISA Sign Expo, signaling they compete on quality and innovation rather than price
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with competitive differentiation—how can Agfa claim the most durable outdoor graphics solution when competing against HP, Canon, and Epson? Position Tedlar as the missing piece that enables Agfa to own the complete durability narrative from ink to protective film

personalization_hooks.hook: As VP of Product Management, they own the tension between what Agfa can control (printer performance) and what they can't control (customer's choice of overlaminate), yet both impact Agfa's brand reputation when graphics fail prematurely
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open with empathy about this control gap—acknowledge that even perfect prints fail when protected with inferior laminates, then position Tedlar partnership as a way to extend Agfa's quality control through validated material recommendations and co-developed application guidelines

recommended_approach: Lead with strategic partnership positioning rather than product features. Frame Tedlar as a solution to Agfa's competitive differentiation challenge—how to own the complete outdoor graphics durability story when competing against HP, Canon, and Epson. Reference their recent Pinnacle Awards and FESPA/ISA presence as evidence they compete on premium positioning, then suggest a conversation about how Tedlar can become part of their validated solution architecture. Keep initial outreach focused on exploring mutual go-to-market alignment rather than asking them to buy anything, since their customers are the actual Tedlar purchasers.
